original_card.question: Is there a genuinely unsearched, explicitly bounded improvement to the selected packing?
methods: Search a named unclaimed canonical candidate domain with a reproducible partition.
Prove a stronger scoped relaxation or exact optimum for one named residual subproblem.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Check live PR overlap first, price both suppliers and distinguish a search best from an optimum. Report the word's packing cap from ceiling.ceiling() and the fraction of it realized; label packing gains as such.

allowed_variations: One bounded residual packing instance or exact relaxation.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.

existing_checks.scope: Packing-independent ceiling for the selected paid profile under the one-unpaid-coordinate coverage and halving guard.

actual_scope: Exact direct FOUR-helper/four-bin cycles on PR3359. Integer hinge certificate proves the stronger one-original-departure/arrival-per-bin obstruction for any concave rank cost.
scope_change_reason: Fixed worker 2 reservation at 2026-10-17T23:12:58.151483+00:00 is disjoint from worker 1 neutral-pair plus triple. No direct four-bin winner appeared; an exact favorable relaxation closes this domain without relying on a search cutoff. The potential proof extends to longer direct permutations without another search.
bottleneck_link: Rules out a fixed-contract residual packing route on the latest pinned composed map; identifies multiple original changes per bin as a concrete escape, independently confirmed by the concurrent supplied witness.
stop_rule: Stop after a source-closed exact certificate or one fully admitted direct4 gain. No extra construction campaign.
evidence: RESULT.json: all 9,284,615 integer inequalities on 197,545 edges and 720 states; PROOF.md gives the all-concave-cost implication. Six behavioral groups include an independent uncompressed graph calculation and the real interacting boundary control.

open_questions.question: Does a corresponding hinge-potential certificate hold on an exact successor map after an interacting multi-helper change?
open_questions.why_it_matters: A new map is outside the source binding; it may admit new direct cycles. The current theorem already closes direct permutations on PR3359.
open_questions.first_step: Reconstruct and pin the successor payload, rebuild the graph and check these potentials before any new search.
open_questions.blocked_by: A named successor and exact owner/window binding. A violated relaxed inequality alone is not a legal gain.

verification_limits: Negative owner/cost theorem only. No changed supplier, full physical invoice, supplier repricing, packing-cap calculation or new kappa is proposed. Both supplier pricing and full invoice are required for a positive construction; they are not rerun here.
ai_assistance: Automated research and verification tooling was used; exact artifacts, commands and review limits are retained.
